thought.text: Ada `authToken` (JWT) dan `clientCredentialGuid` di config halaman. Saya ambil otomatis dari halaman, bukan hardcode.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='gmxtest.py'; t=open(p).read()
t=t.replace('''def main():''','''def page_config():
    """Ambil authToken + clientCredentialGuid + templateName dari config halaman."""
    req = urllib.request.Request(GMX_URL, headers={"User-Agent": UA})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        h = r.read().decode(errors="ignore")
    import re
    cfg = {}
    for k in ("authToken", "clientCredentialGuid", "templateName"):
        m = re.search(r'"%s"\\s*:\\s*"([^"]+)"' % k, h)
        cfg[k] = m.group(1) if m else ""
    return cfg


def main():''')
t=t.replace('''    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/vnd.ui.mam.account.creation+json",''','''    cfg = page_config()
    print(f"ccguid: {cfg['clientCredentialGuid'][:8]}... token: {bool(cfg['authToken'])}")

    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/vnd.ui.mam.account.creation+json",
        "Authorization": cfg["authToken"],
        "X-CCGUID": cfg["clientCredentialGuid"],
        "X-REQUEST-ID": __import__("uuid").uuid4().hex,
        "Template-Name": cfg["templateName"] or "B",''')
t=t.replace('''        "X-UI-APP": "oneReg/1.0.0",
        "Template-Name": "gmx",''','''        "X-UI-APP": "gmxcom/1.0.0",''')
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY
timeout 200 python3 gmxtest.py 2>&1 | tail -18
